First, note: US/Eastern is UTC-5 (standard time, no DST in 1737).  
Asia/Kolkata is UTC+5:30.  

Time difference: target_offset − source_offset = (+5:30) − (-5) = 10 hours 30 minutes.  

7:00 PM = 19:00.  
19:00 + 10:30 = 29:30.  
29:30 − 24:00 = 05:30 next day.  

Date: November 16 → November 17, 1737.  

FINAL_ANSWER: November 17, 1737 05:30
